metadata.title: Codimension Reduction of Minimal Submanifolds with Flat Normal Bundle in Spheres
metadata.abstract: Let $x:M^n\to\mathbb{S}^{n+q}$ be a minimal immersion of a complete connected manifold with flat normal bundle, where $n\ge3$ and $q\ge2$. We prove that if the squared norm of the second fundamental form $S$ satisfies $S<2n$, then $M^n$ lies in $\mathbb{S}^{n+1}$. The standard minimal products of three spheres show that the upper bound $2n$ is optimal. We also prove a codimension reduction theorem under the condition $S+\lambda_2\le 2n+\frac{2n}{3n-2}$, where $\lambda_2$ is the second largest eigenvalue of the Gram matrix of the shape operators, implying that $M^n$ lies in $\mathbb{S}^{n+1}$.

analysis.progressType: 球面平坦法丛极小浸入的降余维
analysis.workSummary: 对完整连通、平坦法丛的球面极小浸入，n≥3、q≥2 且第二基本形式平方 S<2n 时降至余维一；三球乘积说明严格上界最优，另给含 Gram 第二特征值的降余维条件。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出锐阈值及精细谱约束下的降余维。
analysis.limitations: S<2n 为严格不等式；第二个定理使用额外 λ₂ 条件，不能直接视作更宽的 S 单独阈值。
